yxs_glucose.name: Cell yield on glucose, upper limit
yxs_glucose.note: Three chemostat studies of producing and non-producing strains. Sets how much sugar growth takes.

heat_per_o2.name: Heat released per mol of O₂, growing cells
heat_per_o2.note: Measured on many organisms. Sets how hard the tank must be cooled.

yxs_fedbatch.name: Cell yield on glucose in a fed-batch
yxs_fedbatch.note: Three strains in fed-batch; theirs made some ethanol. The model's base batch, growth phase.

yxs_methanol.name: Cell yield on methanol (chemostat)
yxs_methanol.note: A model input since 2026-11-03 (Heijnen's correlation gave 0.447). The O2 uptake below is the test.

qo2_methanol.name: O₂ uptake on methanol at 0.1/h
qo2_methanol.note: Not fitted. Was 21% low with Heijnen's correlation; the measured yield brings it within 7%. Methanol-fed cases only.

yxs_glycerol.name: Cell yield on glycerol (chemostat)
yxs_glycerol.note: No case uses glycerol. The miss shows the Heijnen correlation does not carry over to every feed.

qo2_glycerol.name: O₂ uptake on glycerol at 0.1/h
qo2_glycerol.note: No case uses glycerol. The model's O2 use is about twice the measured.
